summary: @servicetitan/culture preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with string-array rotation obfuscation, hex-named identifiers, and a large opaque decoding table — unrelated to the declared `main` (dist/index.js), which is a ~500-byte React culture/i18n token provider. Using an alternate runtime specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated payload at install time bypasses Node-based inspection tooling and executes arbitrary attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine on `npm install`. The behavior is unrelated to the advertised i18n functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
